tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The results show mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with otherwise normal red cell indices, suggesting a non-severe, likely normocytic anemia. Platelet count is within normal limits, but platelet distribution width is elevated, which may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly due to reactive changes. Leukocyte count is normal. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation for anemia etiology is recommended.
